reason: A command-line wrapper for DeepSeek Harness focused on scriptable coding-agent orchestration, structured output, configurable model parameters, and resumable sessions.

summaries.zh: 通过命令行启动和编排 DeepSeek Harness，支持提示词追加、会话恢复、命名会话、结构化 JSON 输出及模型参数覆盖。
summaries.en: A command-line wrapper for orchestrating DeepSeek Harness with prompt appending, resumable named sessions, structured JSON output, and model parameter overrides.

capabilities: Invokes DeepSeek Harness through a command-line interface
Supports session continuation, resumption, and persistent aliases
Provides structured JSON output for external pipeline orchestration
Allows per-run prompt and model parameter overrides
